# Bree Renee Massage

> Massage therapy in Ephraim, Utah (Sanpete County) by Bree Fowles, licensed massage therapist and Reiki Master.

## Services
- [Swedish massage](https://massagebybree.com/swedish-massage/): Relaxing Swedish massage in Ephraim, Utah with Bree Renee. Gentle, nurturing pressure to ease stress and invite your body to rest. 60, 90 and 120 minutes, from $111.
- [Deep tissue massage](https://massagebybree.com/deep-tissue-massage/): Deep tissue massage in Ephraim, Utah. Firm, focused pressure with trigger point therapy and stretching to melt stubborn knots and ease tension. 60, 90 and 120 minutes, from $122.
- [Reiki & energy work](https://massagebybree.com/reiki-energy-work/): Reiki Master Bree Renee weaves energy work into massage in Ephraim, Utah. Myofascial work meets energetic awareness, so your whole system is held, not just your muscles.

## Prices
- Swedish Massage: from $111
- Deep Tissue Massage: from $122
- Hot Stones: add-on
- Aromatherapy: add-on
- Exact price depends on the length you choose. You'll see it before you confirm in the booking app.
- New male clients are welcomed by referral from an existing client.
